subject: spanish
title: School Things
welcome_lead: Boli, libro, regla — Spanish school stuff.
final_note: Name what's on your Spanish desk.

walkthroughs.body_html: Spanish uses el (m) and la (f). Most -o words are masculine ('el libro'), most -a are feminine ('la regla'). Learn the gender with each word.
'En mi mochila hay un libro y una regla' = 'In my bag there is a book and a ruler'. Un (m) and una (f) = a/an.
Add -s for plurals: los libros (the books), las reglas (the rulers). 'Los' (m) and 'las' (f) = the (plural).
